# Philips: packages disabled across 23 tested list(s) for this brand.
# Use ONLY when your exact model has no list in models/. Generated by tools/build_index.py.
# A package appears here if at least 2 list(s) disabled it. The count is how many.
# Higher count = more sets survived it. Still apply in batches and check after each reboot.
# Format: <package>  # <count>/<lists> <most common note>

Kills the remote's mic button, "Hey Google", on-screen voice search and the mic icon inside YouTube and Play Store search. Settings and tvsystemui guard their calls into it, so nothing crashes
